data_description.name: Naam voor uw zwembadrobot in Home Assistant
data_description.include_seconds_remaining: When enabled, the time-remaining sensor updates every poll interval (every few seconds) and includes seconds in its value. Disable to update only when the minute ticks over — this dramatically reduces Home Assistant activity-log entries during long cleaning cycles without slowing down remote-control button responsiveness. Can be toggled later via Configure.

select_device.title: Robot Selecteren
select_device.description: Selecteer welke robot u wilt toevoegen aan Home Assistant.

data_description.device: Kies de robot die u wilt toevoegen
data_description.name: Optioneel: Overschrijf de standaardnaam voor deze robot

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate iAqualink Robot
reauth_confirm.description: Your iAquaLink credentials for {username} are no longer accepted. Enter the current password to resume the integration without losing entity history.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure iAqualink Robot
reconfigure.description: Update the iAquaLink account used for {name}. The robot must still be listed on the new account — its serial number stays the same, so all entities, history and automations are preserved.

data_description.username: The iAquaLink account username (e-mail address) that now owns this robot
data_description.password: The password for that iAquaLink account

error.cannot_connect: Kan geen verbinding maken met iAquaLink service. Controleer uw gegevens en probeer opnieuw.
error.no_devices: Geen robots gevonden op uw account. Controleer of uw robot correct geregistreerd is bij iAquaLink.
error.device_not_found: Geselecteerde apparaat kon niet gevonden worden. Probeer opnieuw.
error.unknown: Er is een onverwachte fout opgetreden. Probeer opnieuw.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid iAquaLink credentials. Please check your username and password and try again.
error.wrong_account: Those credentials are valid, but this robot is not listed on that iAquaLink account. Check that you signed in with the account the robot is registered to.

abort.already_configured: Deze robot is al geconfigureerd in Home Assistant.
abort.no_serial: No serial number was returned for this robot. The cloud account is reachable but the device list is empty or incomplete. Please try again later.
abort.reauth_successful: Reauthentication successful. The integration has resumed.
abort.reauth_unavailable: Reauthentication is no longer available for this entry (it may have been deleted). Please delete and re-add the integration if needed.
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration of this robot is already in progress.
abort.wrong_robot: The selected account does not match the robot this entry was set up for. The entry was left unchanged.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Account updated. The integration has reloaded.

Disable to update only when the minute ticks over — this dramatically reduces Home Assistant activity-log entries during long cleaning cycles without slowing down remote-control button responsiveness.

confirm.title: Bevestig gewijzigd service-gedrag
confirm.description: Open uw automatiseringen en scripts en controleer alle die `iaqualink_robots.remote_forward`, `remote_backward`, `remote_rotate_left`, `remote_rotate_right`, `remote_stop`, `add_fifteen_minutes` of `reduce_fifteen_minutes` aanroepen. Deze services bewegen nu de robot echt in plaats van stilzwijgend te falen. Klik op Verzenden zodra u ze heeft gecontroleerd — deze melding zal niet opnieuw verschijnen.
